items.mainDefect: Authenticate now runs TagDevice synchronously on the request context, so every anonymous auth cache-miss waits on a DB write and gets slower.

secondary.defect: The panic recovery that guarded device tagging was removed, so a panic during tagging now reaches the anonymous auth flow.

items.mainDefect: The synchronous TagDevice call uses the request ctx instead of its own bounded 2-minute context, so tagging no longer has its own deadline.

secondary.defect: The defer recover() panic guard was removed, so a panic inside device tagging now reaches the anonymous auth request instead of being logged and contained.
